data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** f91f1abb960035834d626a1a3de137b3fbebf99e

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

`_VALIDATE_REVIEW_SCHEMA_HASH` in `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py` must equal `HASH_CODE_REVIEW_DISPATCH` in `plugins/dso/scripts/validate-review-output.sh`. The test `test_validate_review_schema_hash_matches_script` in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py` verifies this invariant.

#### Actual Behavior

CI run 25890306884 on PR #124 fails with:
`AssertionError: assert '214949ee476be6d0' == 'cb48a66fc3292083'`

The constant in runner.py was not updated when validate-review-output.sh was modified during the sprint. Locally the test passes because `_resolve_validator_script()` returns the main repo path (old hash), not the worktree path. CI checks out the PR branch and sees the updated hash.

#### Root Cause (observed)

`runner.py:153` has `_VALIDATE_REVIEW_SCHEMA_HASH = "214949ee476be6d0"`.
`validate-review-output.sh:73` has `HASH_CODE_REVIEW_DISPATCH="cb48a66fc3292083"`.
The constant was not updated when the script hash was changed.
data.title: [runner.py]: _VALIDATE_REVIEW_SCHEMA_HASH stale constant -> test_validate_review_schema_hash_matches_script fails in CI
